comments.body: Thanks for the approval! The red run looks like an infrastructure hiccup: the "Get programs" tool-install step failed and fail-fast cancelled the remaining jobs before any test ran. Could you re-run the failed jobs when you get a chance?
Thanks, rebased onto the current master. The branch is a single commit again; the new workflows will run on this push, so the earlier cancelled run no longer needs a re-run.
Friendly ping: this is approved and CI is green on the rebased commit. Is anything else needed from my side before it can be merged?
Hi @MichaelEischer, thanks for the approval. Is anything else needed from my side before this can be merged?
